name: Ski Erg
steps: Stand facing a ski erg machine with your feet shoulder-width apart and reach high overhead to grip both handles with your arms slightly bent.
Hinge at your hips and soften your knees as you draw the handles down alongside your thighs.
Finish the stroke with your elbows slightly bent behind your hips and torso angled forward.
Extend smoothly back upright as your arms rise overhead to start the next pull, continuing at an even rhythm for the target duration or distance.
tips: Use your abs, lats, and hip hinge together rather than pulling strictly with your arms.
Keep your shoulders down and avoid squatting excessively low on every stroke.
